newsitem.title: UK: Centrica, BG trading starts in "grey market".
newsitem.headline: Centrica, BG trading starts in "grey market".

text.p: Shares in Centrica Plc and BG Plc began trading on Monday in a "grey market" ahead of the official demerger of British Gas's natural gas trading arm Centrica from its gas distribution business.
By 0840 Centrica shares were quoted at 61-1/4p while BG shares were quoted at 181p.
Existing shares in British Gas were down 1-1/2p at 242.
British Gas shareholders vote on the demerger plan on Wednesday yet market-makers have started trading the shares on a "when-issued" basis, known as the grey market.
Analysts have struggled to place a valuation on Centrica, which has said it will not pay dividends in the short-term.
